summary: Revised the fixed replay-completion experiment (previous_id 29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-experiment) to measure the bound instead of inferring it: the harness now parameterizes MaxAppendEntries and adds two flag-on cases at MaxAppendEntries 16, one with ~1500 replayed entries (94 batches, below the 128-slot channel) and one with ~3000 (188 batches, above it), asserting only that NewRaft returns, with a stack sample of the blocked goroutine reported when it does not. Two admissions and two comparisons encode the pair; the original 9000-entry default-batch cases and their event names are unchanged, so the earlier receipt's basis is preserved. Local construction feedback showed the below-bound case returning and the above-bound case blocking with restoreFromCommittedLogs in the stack; the retained receipt is pending, and the sibling configuration-recovery defect (the below-bound restart still not electing) is reported but not asserted in this experiment.
